headline: KCR @ TBR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is KCR 4.26 at TBR 4.92, with a projected total of 9.18. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TBR: KCR moved +0.17 runs while TBR moved +0.62, changing the projected margin by -0.45 runs. The projected total climbed +0.78, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -13.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Shane McClanahan has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Carter Jensen, Bobby Witt Jr., Yandy Díaz, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production.
